# `<fs/protocols/fsd.h>`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

fsd's protocol: sessions, requests and the shared buffer.

fsd (fs daemon) is the zuzuOS VFS. It talks to a block driver through a filesystem backend shim and serves clients over a port registered as "/svc/fsd".

Sessions. A caller reaches fsd on an unmarked handle (from LookupService), which may only send FSD_ATTACH, granting a shared page it created (the client pays for it; the page size rides in FsdRequest.data_len). fsd allocates a session, maps the page and replies granting a PERM_SEND|PERM_TXFR duplicate of its own port stamped with a marker, FSD_BADGE(generation, slot). Every later request goes on that badged handle; fsd reads the marker from the receive result and rejects anything that does not match a live session, so a session cannot be guessed or forged. FSD_DETACH frees the session; so does the death of the client, once it has sent FSD_WATCH with a port it owns. fds are per session.

Requests. The payload is an [FsdRequest](#fsdrequest) in the message buffer. Paths and file data live in the shared page at data_off >= FSD_DATA_OFF; fsd checks data_off/data_len against the page and copies a path out before using it. The reply payload is an [FsdResponse](#fsdresponse) in the message buffer; READ, STAT, READDIR results are placed in the shared page at resp.data_off.

```c
#include <fs/protocols/fsd.h>
```

## Constants

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="fsd_data_off"></a>`FSD_DATA_OFF` | `128u` | Payloads start at or after this offset in the shared buffer. |
| <a id="fsd_page_size"></a>`FSD_PAGE_SIZE` | `4096u` | Shared buffers are sized in pages of this many bytes. |
| <a id="fsd_shm_min"></a>`FSD_SHM_MIN` | `4096u` | Smallest shared buffer fsd accepts. |
| <a id="fsd_shm_default"></a>`FSD_SHM_DEFAULT` | `(64 * 1024)` | Suggested shared buffer size. |
| <a id="fsd_shm_max"></a>`FSD_SHM_MAX` | `(4 * 1024 * 1024)` | Largest shared buffer fsd accepts. |
| <a id="fsd_badge"></a>`FSD_BADGE(gen, slot)` |  | Session marker: generation above bit 8, session slot below. |
| <a id="fsd_badge_slot"></a>`FSD_BADGE_SLOT(badge)` |  | Session slot of a marker. |
| <a id="fsd_badge_gen"></a>`FSD_BADGE_GEN(badge)` |  | Session generation of a marker. |
| <a id="fsd_mode_read"></a>`FSD_MODE_READ` | `0x01` | OPEN: read access. |
| <a id="fsd_mode_write"></a>`FSD_MODE_WRITE` | `0x02` | OPEN: write access. |
| <a id="fsd_mode_create_new"></a>`FSD_MODE_CREATE_NEW` | `0x04` | OPEN: create the file; fail if it exists. |
| <a id="fsd_mode_create_always"></a>`FSD_MODE_CREATE_ALWAYS` | `0x08` | OPEN: create the file, or truncate it if it exists (O_CREAT \| O_TRUNC). |
| <a id="fsd_mode_open_always"></a>`FSD_MODE_OPEN_ALWAYS` | `0x10` | OPEN: create the file if it is missing (O_CREAT). |
| <a id="fsd_mode_open_append"></a>`FSD_MODE_OPEN_APPEND` | `0x30` | OPEN: open or create, positioned at the end (O_APPEND). |

## Enumerations

### `FsdWhence` { #fsdwhence }

What a SEEK offset is relative to.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `FSD_SEEK_SET` | `0` | The start of the file. |
| `FSD_SEEK_CUR` | `1` | The current position. |
| `FSD_SEEK_END` | `2` | The end of the file. |

### `FsdFileType` { #fsdfiletype }

Kind of a directory entry.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `FSD_TYPE_FILE` | `0` | Regular file. |
| `FSD_TYPE_DIR` | `1` | Directory. |
| `FSD_TYPE_SYMLINK` | `2` | Symbolic link. |

### `FsdCommand` { #fsdcommand }

Request commands.

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `FSD_ATTACH` | `1` | On the unmarked handle: grants the shared buffer, data_len = its size; replies with the session's badged port. |
| `FSD_OPEN` | `2` | Path in the buffer, mode; replies fd. |
| `FSD_CLOSE` | `3` | fd. |
| `FSD_READ` | `4` | fd, data_len = count; replies count, data in the buffer. |
| `FSD_WRITE` | `5` | fd, data_len = count, data in the buffer; replies count. |
| `FSD_SEEK` | `6` | fd, offset, whence; replies the new offset. |
| `FSD_STAT` | `7` | Path in the buffer; replies an [FsdStat](#fsdstat) in the buffer. |
| `FSD_FSTAT` | `8` | fd; replies an [FsdStat](#fsdstat) in the buffer. |
| `FSD_READDIR` | `9` | Path in the buffer, offset = first entry; replies [FsdDirEntry](#fsddirentry) records and count. |
| `FSD_UNLINK` | `10` | Path in the buffer. |
| `FSD_RENAME` | `11` | Two paths in the buffer. |
| `FSD_DETACH` | `12` | Ends the session. |
| `FSD_WATCH` | `13` | Grants a port the client owns (PERM_WAIT \| PERM_TXFR); fsd frees the session when it dies. |
| `FSD_READ_OBJ` | `14` | Grants a memory object (PERM_MAP \| PERM_WRITE \| PERM_TXFR); fd, data_off = offset into the object, data_len = count. Replies count; the data lands in the object. |

## Structures

### `FsdRequest` { #fsdrequest }

A request, in the message buffer.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `size` | `uint32_t` | sizeof(FsdRequest); the client sets it, fsd checks it. |
| `cmd` | `uint32_t` | An [FsdCommand](#fsdcommand). |
| `data_off` | `uint32_t` | Offset of the payload in the shared buffer, at least FSD_DATA_OFF. |
| `data_len` | `uint32_t` | Payload length, or the byte count for READ and WRITE. |
| `offset` | `int64_t` | SEEK offset, or the first entry for READDIR. |
| `fd` | `uint32_t` | File descriptor, for commands on an open file. |
| `whence` | `uint32_t` | SEEK: an [FsdWhence](#fsdwhence). |
| `mode` | `uint32_t` | OPEN: FSD_MODE_* flags. |
| `flags` | `uint32_t` | Reserved; 0. |

### `FsdResponse` { #fsdresponse }

A reply, in the message buffer.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `size` | `uint32_t` | sizeof(FsdResponse); fsd sets it. |
| `status` | [`Err`](../../../errors.md#err) | ZUZU_OK, or an error code. |
| `data_off` | `uint32_t` | Where fsd put the payload in the shared buffer. |
| `data_len` | `uint32_t` | Payload length. |
| `offset` | `int64_t` | SEEK: the new absolute position. |
| `count` | `uint32_t` | Bytes for READ and WRITE, entries for READDIR. |
| `fd` | `uint32_t` | OPEN: the new file descriptor. |
| `flags` | `uint32_t` | Reserved. |
| `_rsv` | `uint32_t` | Reserved. |

### `FsdDirEntry` { #fsddirentry }

One READDIR entry in the shared buffer; 64 bytes.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `char` | NUL-terminated UTF-8 name. |
| `size` | `uint32_t` | File size in bytes. |
| `type` | `uint8_t` | An [FsdFileType](#fsdfiletype). |
| `_pad` | `uint8_t` | Padding. |

### `FsdStat` { #fsdstat }

STAT and FSTAT result in the shared buffer.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `size` | `uint32_t` | File size in bytes. |
| `type` | `uint8_t` | An [FsdFileType](#fsdfiletype). |
| `_pad` | `uint8_t` | Padding. |
| `mtime` | `uint32_t` | FAT date << 16 \| FAT time; 0 when the backend cannot say. |
